title: First steps with map and filter
hints: `map` changes every item; `filter` keeps some items. Each takes a small function that gets one item at a time.
For `shoutAll`, the arrow function returns the uppercased word. For `longWords`, it returns `true` when the word is long enough (`>=`).
shoutAll: `return words.map((w) => w.toUpperCase());`  longWords: `return words.filter((w) => w.length >= minLength);`
